title: Recon→assets→intents→evidence→findings (end-to-end)
detail: 1) **Recon** (bucketed, multi-target): fast sweep → liveness → service fingerprint (prefer structured: masscan -oJ, nmap -oX, httpx -json). Respect scope/rate; ICS = read-identify, no write/control. 2) **Assets**: normalize & de-dup into host/service/endpoint/app assets; tag exposure (mgmt/auth/ICS/db/web). 3) **Intents**: per bucket, create high-value non-overlapping intents with deps (from facts), timebox, and expected evidence. 4) **Evidence**: capture proof (traffic, command output, artifact refs); parse structured output into facts. 5) **Findings**: confirmed vuln + evidence → register finding (and vuln fact) with repro/impact/scope; bind evidence. 6) **Feedback**: success → reusable intel/hints; failure → fact with tried+blocker+reason → new intent or park. Validate graph; avoid duplicates via recall.
